The exact value is "CV-Services"; a JQL '~' search chokes on the hyphen, so use '='.
_forecast_note: A small team with a steady ramp: 0, 0, 3, 3, 4 epics (25.4 -> 26.4). The last-3 average (3.3) would sit below the latest release for a team whose trend is flat to slightly up, so 27.1 holds 26.4's level: 4. That is under Kobi's 2026-10-07 cap of 125% of 26.4's actual (4 * 1.25 = 5). At this size one epic is a 25% swing, so treat the number as a rough guide. No India-festival leave adjustment has been applied: the 2026-10-08 feedback named only CXCO and Ascenders as affected, and this team's location has not been confirmed.
